### When Tragedy Strikes
Author: Pastor Chuck Swindoll
Site: Insight for Living Ministries
URL: https://insight.org/resources/daily-devotional/individual/when-tragedy-strikes1
Passage: 1 Kings 17:17-19
Points:
- Elijah responded with patient gentleness and silence instead of defending himself against the grieving mother's blame.
- His gentle spirit diffused the tension, prompting the distraught widow to entrust her lifeless son into his care.
- Elijah took the child up to his private room, a place where he was already accustomed to meeting God in prayer.
- Having a consistent place of solitude and prayer prepares believers to meet life's sudden crises with calm faith rather than panic.

### Painful Surprises
Author: Leading The Way
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/leading-the-way/leading-the-way-week-of-october-17.html
Passage: 1 Kings 17:18-24
Points:
- Following God in faithful obedience does not guarantee exemption from sudden and heartbreaking trials.
- Elijah chose not to argue with the grieving widow, taking his raw anguish directly to God instead.
- The Lord heard the prophet's earnest plea, returned the breath of life to the boy, and brought healing out of tragedy.
- Witnessing her son's resurrection convinced the mother of the reliability of God's word and Elijah's ministry.
- Difficult circumstances remind believers to keep a regular place of prayer to seek God's restoring power.
